note: Set B is preferred because it correctly identifies the drawing scale and more accurately binds dimensions to their respective modules (e.g., assigning 2'-11 7/8" to Module A), whereas Set A frequently misattributes Module A dimensions to Module B or uses vague entities. However, Set B contains a clear extraction error ('4 13"' instead of '4 13/16"') and formatting issues, while Set A trusts an OCR error ('12'-3 3/4"' vs image '10'-3 3/4"') and has more generic claims.
